CREATE PROCEDURE CDN.MobS_EksportNumeryDok @CentrumID INT AS BEGIN declare @RejestrKasowy varchar(20) create table #kasa(Rejestr varchar(20) COLLATE Polish_CI_AS, nrRap int, rokRap smallint, Stan decimal(15,4)) insert into #kasa exec cdn.mobs_eksportkar @CentrumID select @RejestrKasowy = Rejestr from #kasa drop table #kasa
declare @numery table (TrN_TrNNumer int, TrN_TrNTyp int, TrN_TrNRok int, TrN_TrNMiesiac int, TrN_TrNSeria int) declare @data datetime set @data=getdate()
if exists(select * from cdn.konfig where kon_numer=992 and (charindex('6',Kon_wartosc)>0 or charindex('7',Kon_wartosc)>0)) BEGIN INSERT INTO @numery SELECT isnull(max(TrN_TrNNumer),0)+1 as TrN_TrNNumer, TrN_GIDTyp as TrN_TrNTyp, TrN_TrNRok, TrN_TrNMiesiac, SER_GIDNumer as TrN_TrNSeria FROM CDN.TraNag JOIN CDN.Serie on trn_trnseria=ser_nazwa JOIN CDN.FrmObiekty ON SER_GIDNumer=FrO_GIDNumer WHERE TrN_TrNLp=127 and fro_frmid=@CentrumID and fro_gidtyp=272 and trn_trnrok*100+trn_trnmiesiac<=year(@data)*100+month(@data) and trn_trnrok*100+trn_trnmiesiac>=(year(@data)-1)*100+month(@data) and trn_gidtyp in (2001,2033,2034,1603,1604) GROUP BY trn_gidtyp,trn_trnrok,trn_trnmiesiac,ser_gidnumer UNION ALL SELECT isnull(max(RLN_Numer),0)+1 as TrN_TrNNumer, RLN_Typ as TrN_TrNTyp,RLN_Rok as TrN_TrNRok ,RLN_Miesiac as TrN_TrnMiesiac,ser_gidnumer as TRN_TrNSeria FROM CDN.ReklNag JOIN CDN.serie on Rln_Seria = Ser_Nazwa JOIN CDN.frmobiekty on ser_gidnumer=fro_gidnumer WHERE RLN_Lp=127 and fro_frmid=@CentrumID and fro_gidtyp=272 and RLN_Rok*100+RLN_Miesiac<=year(@data)*100+month(@data) and RLN_Rok*100+RLN_Miesiac>=(year(@data)-1)*100+month(@data) and RLN_Typ = 3584 GROUP BY RLN_Typ,RLN_Rok,RLN_Miesiac, ser_gidnumer UNION ALL SELECT isnull(max(zan_zamnumer),0) + 1 AS TrN_TrNNumer ,cdn.dokmaptypdokumentu(zan_gidtyp, zan_zamtyp, zan_rodzaj) As TrN_TrNTyp,zan_zamrok As TrN_TrNRok,zan_zammiesiac as TrN_TrNMiesiac,ser_gidnumer As TrN_TrNSeria FROM CDN.ZamNag JOIN CDN.serie on zan_zamseria=ser_nazwa JOIN CDN.frmobiekty on ser_gidnumer=fro_gidnumer WHERE fro_frmid=@CentrumID and fro_gidtyp=272 and zan_zamrok*100+zan_zammiesiac<=year(@data)*100+month(@data) and zan_zamrok*100+zan_zammiesiac>=(year(@data)-1)*100+month(@data) and cdn.dokmaptypdokumentu(zan_gidtyp, zan_zamtyp, zan_rodzaj) IN (8960,9472) GROUP BY cdn.dokmaptypdokumentu(zan_gidtyp, zan_zamtyp, zan_rodzaj),zan_zamrok,zan_zammiesiac,ser_gidnumer UNION ALL SELECT isnull(max(CWN_Numer),0) + 1, 4180, CWN_Rok, CWN_Miesiac, SER_GIDNumer FROM CDN.CRMWizytyNag JOIN CDN.Serie on CWN_Seria=SER_Nazwa JOIN CDN.FrmObiekty on SER_GIDNumer=fro_gidnumer WHERE FRO_FRMID=@CentrumID and FRO_GIDTyp=272 AND CWN_Rok*100+CWN_Miesiac<=year(@data)*100+month(@data) GROUP BY CWN_Rok,CWN_Miesiac,SER_GIDNumer END ELSE BEGIN INSERT INTO @numery SELECT isnull(max(trn_trnnumer),0)+1 as TrN_TrNNumer, trn_gidtyp as TrN_TrNTyp, TrN_TrNRok, 0 as TrN_TrNMiesiac, SER_GIDNumer as TrN_TrNSeria from cdn.tranag join cdn.serie on trn_trnseria=ser_nazwa join cdn.frmobiekty on ser_gidnumer=fro_gidnumer where trn_trnlp=127 and fro_frmid=@CentrumID and fro_gidtyp=272 and trn_trnrok in (year(@data), year(@data)-1) and trn_gidtyp in (2001,2033,2034,1603,1604) group by trn_gidtyp,trn_trnrok,ser_gidnumer UNION ALL Select isnull(max(RLN_Numer),0)+1 as TrN_TrNNumer, RLN_Typ as TrN_TrNTyp, RLN_Rok as TrN_TrNRok, 0 as TrN_TrnMiesiac, ser_gidnumer as TRN_TrNSeria from CDN.ReklNag join cdn.serie on Rln_Seria = Ser_Nazwa join cdn.frmobiekty on ser_gidnumer=fro_gidnumer where RLN_Lp=127 and fro_frmid=@CentrumID and fro_gidtyp=272 and RLN_Rok in (year(@data), year(@data)-1) and RLN_Typ = 3584 group by RLN_Typ,RLN_Rok,SER_GIDNumer UNION ALL select isnull(max(zan_zamnumer),0) + 1 AS TrN_TrNNumer, cdn.dokmaptypdokumentu(zan_gidtyp, zan_zamtyp, zan_rodzaj) As TrN_TrNTyp, zan_zamrok As TrN_TrNRok, 0 as TrN_TrNMiesiac, ser_gidnumer As TrN_TrNSeria from cdn.zamnag join cdn.serie on zan_zamseria=ser_nazwa join cdn.frmobiekty on ser_gidnumer=fro_gidnumer where fro_frmid=@CentrumID and fro_gidtyp=272 and zan_zamrok in (year(@data), year(@data)-1) and cdn.dokmaptypdokumentu(zan_gidtyp, zan_zamtyp, zan_rodzaj) IN (8960,9472) group by cdn.dokmaptypdokumentu(zan_gidtyp, zan_zamtyp, zan_rodzaj),zan_zamrok,ser_gidnumer UNION ALL SELECT isnull(max(CWN_Numer),0) + 1, 4180, CWN_Rok, 0 As CWN_Miesiac, SER_GIDNumer FROM CDN.CRMWizytyNag JOIN CDN.Serie on CWN_Seria=SER_Nazwa JOIN CDN.FrmObiekty on SER_GIDNumer=fro_gidnumer WHERE FRO_FRMID=@CentrumID and FRO_GIDTyp=272 AND CWN_Rok*100+CWN_Miesiac<=year(@data)*100+month(@data) GROUP BY CWN_Rok,SER_GIDNumer end
select * from @numery UNION ALL SELECT isnull(max(cast(substring(KAZ_NumerDokumentu,4,charindex('/',kaz_numerdokumentu)-4) as integer)),0)+1 as TrN_TrNNumer ,7841 as TrN_TrNTyp ,year(@data) as TrN_TrNRok ,0 as TrN_TrNMiesiac ,-1 as TrN_TrNSeria from cdn.raporty join cdn.zapisy on KRP_GIDNumer=KAZ_KRPNumer where krp_seria=@RejestrKasowy and charindex('KP-',KAZ_NumerDokumentu)>0 and krp_rok=year(@data) union select isnull(max(cast(substring(KAZ_NumerDokumentu,4,charindex('/',kaz_numerdokumentu)-4) as integer)),0)+1 as TrN_TrNNumer ,7842 as TrN_TrNTyp ,year(@data) as TrN_TrNRok ,0 as TrN_TrNRok ,-1 as TrN_TrNSeria from cdn.raporty join cdn.zapisy on KRP_GIDNumer=KAZ_KRPNumer where krp_seria=@RejestrKasowy and charindex('KW-',KAZ_NumerDokumentu)>0 and krp_rok=year(@data) END
